alternatives.description: Horizontal scaling with bounded cache and version-aware invalidation

scenario_arguments.claim: Cache hits reduce backend read load on scaled replicas.
grounds: EV-TRACE records more cache hits and fewer storage reads.
scenario_arguments.warrant: A fresh cache hit skips a storage read.
backing: Catalogue entry on maintaining multiple copies.
scenario_arguments.qualifier: Applies to warm cache traffic with reachable version checks.
scenario_arguments.rebuttal: Simultaneous cold misses can saturate the authoritative store.
